content.json:
## Am I Being Pwned

Browser extension alerts, detections and agent removals from Am I Being Pwned. Every panel follows the time range above.

content.query:
AIBPEvents_CL
| where EventType == "alert.raised"
// make-series fills empty bins with 0, so a quiet period reads as zero, not as a line drawn across it.
| make-series Alerts = dcount(AlertId) default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain} by AlertTier
content.title: Alerts over time by tier

content.query:
AIBPEvents_CL
| where EventType in ("alert.raised", "threat.detected")
| summarize Alerts = dcountif(AlertId, EventType == "alert.raised"), Detections = countif(EventType == "threat.detected"), MaxInstalls = max(InstallCount), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by ExtensionId, ExtensionName
| sort by Alerts desc, MaxInstalls desc
| take 20
content.title: Extensions with the most alerts

content.query:
AIBPEvents_CL
| where EventType == "device.uninstalled"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventId
| project TimeGenerated, IdentityEmail, Platform, DeviceId, MachineName, EnrolledDays = toint(Data.enrolledDays)
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent browser agent removals
